get.summary: Continuous protected events, resumed from a P4a cursor.

parameters.name: Nemein-Connection-Version
parameters.description: P1 connection version, independent of API and action versions.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Snapshot cursor on first connection; last processed event cursor on reconnect. Duplicates are rejected. Never a CloudEvents id.

200.description: UTF-8 SSE. budget-event has id=cursor and JSON data matching event-stream. Heartbeat comments have no id. stream-error carries a sanitized Error without id, then closes. Persist after processing and deduplicate source+id. Slow consumers are disconnected; reconnect from the persisted cursor. Continuous events require allow; permissions are checked throughout.
